task.title: Watcherless publishing switch flips server config invisibly
task.description: Found in PR #107's review (M1, pinned by test as pre-existing behavior). With sync configured deferred and no watcher answering, the header's Publishing switch reads off; activating it ping-pongs the server deferred->inline->deferred while the knob never moves and aria-checked stays false - a user clicks a few times, sees nothing, gives up, and later starts a watcher to find their publishing mode at whatever parity the no-op clicking landed on. The old text button behaved identically, but a knob that never moves promises more than a text label did. Fix direction: surface watcher absence instead of offering a dead toggle - e.g. the switch disabled with a title explaining no watcher is answering, or a distinct stalled state.
